+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_EMBEDDINGS_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings"
+OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "text-embedding-3-small")
+
+
+def _provider_headers() -> Dict[str, str]:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
+
+
+def summarize_embedding_job(job: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    inputs: List[str] = job.get("inputs", [])
+    if not isinstance(inputs, list):
+        raise TypeError("job['inputs'] must be a list of strings")
+
+    payload = {"model": OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL, "input": inputs}
+    response = requests.post(OPENAI_EMBEDDINGS_URL, json=payload, headers=_provider_headers(), timeout=60)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    embeddings = data.get("data", [])
+    dims = len(embeddings[0]["embedding"]) if embeddings else 0
+
+    return {
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL,
+        "input_count": len(inputs),
+        "embedding_count": len(embeddings),
+        "embedding_dimensions": dims,
+        "usage": data.get("usage", {}),
+    }
+
+
+def main(job: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if job is None:
+        job = {"inputs": [os.getenv("EMBEDDING_SUMMARY_TEXT", "example text")]}
+    return summarize_embedding_job(job)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    print(main())
*** End Patch

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Iterable, Mapping, Sequence
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class EmbeddingsRequest:
+    model: str
+    input: str | Sequence[str] | Sequence[Sequence[int]]
+    encoding_format: str | None = None
+    user: str | None = None
+    dimensions: int | None = None
+    extra_body: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    def to_payload(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        payload: dict[str, Any] = {"model": self.model, "input": self.input}
+        if self.encoding_format is not None:
+            payload["encoding_format"] = self.encoding_format
+        if self.user is not None:
+            payload["user"] = self.user
+        if self.dimensions is not None:
+            payload["dimensions"] = self.dimensions
+        payload.update(dict(self.extra_body))
+        return payload
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class EmbeddingsData:
+    index: int
+    embedding: list[float]
+    object: str | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class EmbeddingsResponse:
+    object: str
+    model: str
+    data: list[EmbeddingsData]
+    usage: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+
+
+def _normalize_embedding(value: Any) -> list[float]:
+    if value is None:
+        return []
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return [float(v) for v in value]
+    if isinstance(value, tuple):
+        return [float(v) for v in value]
+    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
+        return [float(v) for v in value]
+    raise TypeError(f"Unsupported embedding type: {type(value)!r}")
+
+
+def normalize_embeddings_response(raw: Mapping[str, Any]) -> EmbeddingsResponse:
+    data_items: list[EmbeddingsData] = []
+    for item in raw.get("data", []) or []:
+        if not isinstance(item, Mapping):
+            continue
+        data_items.append(
+            EmbeddingsData(
+                index=int(item.get("index", 0)),
+                embedding=_normalize_embedding(item.get("embedding")),
+                object=item.get("object"),
+            )
+        )
+    return EmbeddingsResponse(
+        object=str(raw.get("object", "list")),
+        model=str(raw.get("model", "")),
+        data=data_items,
+        usage=dict(raw["usage"]) if isinstance(raw.get("usage"), Mapping) else None,
+    )
+
+
+def normalize_embeddings_input(value: Any) -> str | list[str] | list[list[int]]:
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, (bytes, bytearray)):
+        if all(isinstance(item, str) for item in value):
+            return [str(item) for item in value]
+        if all(isinstance(item, Sequence) and not isinstance(item, (str, bytes, bytearray)) for item in value):
+            return [[int(v) for v in item] for item in value]
+    raise TypeError("input must be a string, list of strings, or list of token sequences")
+
*** End Patch

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Iterable, List, Sequence
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "text-embedding-3-small")
+DEFAULT_BASE_URL = os.getenv("OPENAI_BASE_URL")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class EmbeddingsConfig:
+    api_key: str
+    model: str = DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL
+    base_url: str | None = DEFAULT_BASE_URL
+
+
+def load_config() -> EmbeddingsConfig:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return EmbeddingsConfig(
+        api_key=api_key,
+        model=os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL),
+        base_url=os.getenv("OPENAI_BASE_URL", DEFAULT_BASE_URL) or None,
+    )
+
+
+def create_client(config: EmbeddingsConfig | None = None) -> OpenAI:
+    config = config or load_config()
+    kwargs = {"api_key": config.api_key}
+    if config.base_url:
+        kwargs["base_url"] = config.base_url
+    return OpenAI(**kwargs)
+
+
+def embed_text(text: str, config: EmbeddingsConfig | None = None) -> List[float]:
+    config = config or load_config()
+    client = create_client(config)
+    response = client.embeddings.create(model=config.model, input=text)
+    return list(response.data[0].embedding)
+
+
+def embed_texts(texts: Sequence[str], config: EmbeddingsConfig | None = None) -> List[List[float]]:
+    config = config or load_config()
+    client = create_client(config)
+    response = client.embeddings.create(model=config.model, input=list(texts))
+    return [list(item.embedding) for item in response.data]
+
+
+def normalize_vector(vector: Iterable[float]) -> List[float]:
+    values = list(vector)
+    magnitude = sum(v * v for v in values) ** 0.5
+    if magnitude == 0:
+        return values
+    return [v / magnitude for v in values]
+
+
+def cosine_similarity(left: Sequence[float], right: Sequence[float]) -> float:
+    if len(left) != len(right):
+        raise ValueError("Vectors must have the same length")
+    return sum(a * b for a, b in zip(left, right))
*** End Patch

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Iterable, List, Sequence
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "text-embedding-3-small")
+DEFAULT_BASE_URL = os.getenv("OPENAI_BASE_URL")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class EmbeddingsConfig:
+    api_key: str
+    model: str = DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL
+    base_url: str | None = DEFAULT_BASE_URL
+
+
+def load_config() -> EmbeddingsConfig:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return EmbeddingsConfig(
+        api_key=api_key,
+        model=os.getenv("OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL),
+        base_url=os.getenv("OPENAI_BASE_URL", DEFAULT_BASE_URL) or None,
+    )
+
+
+def create_client(config: EmbeddingsConfig | None = None) -> OpenAI:
+    config = config or load_config()
+    kwargs = {"api_key": config.api_key}
+    if config.base_url:
+        kwargs["base_url"] = config.base_url
+    return OpenAI(**kwargs)
+
+
+def embed_text(text: str, config: EmbeddingsConfig | None = None) -> List[float]:
+    config = config or load_config()
+    client = create_client(config)
+    response = client.embeddings.create(model=config.model, input=text)
+    return list(response.data[0].embedding)
+
+
+def embed_texts(texts: Sequence[str], config: EmbeddingsConfig | None = None) -> List[List[float]]:
+    config = config or load_config()
+    client = create_client(config)
+    response = client.embeddings.create(model=config.model, input=list(texts))
+    return [list(item.embedding) for item in response.data]
+
+
+def normalize_vector(vector: Iterable[float]) -> List[float]:
+    values = list(vector)
+    magnitude = sum(v * v for v in values) ** 0.5
+    if magnitude == 0:
+        return values
+    return [v / magnitude for v in values]
+
+
+def cosine_similarity(left: Sequence[float], right: Sequence[float]) -> float:
+    if len(left) != len(right):
+        raise ValueError("Vectors must have the same length")
+    return sum(a * b for a, b in zip(left, right))

+import os
+from typing import Iterable, List, Sequence
+
+import requests
+
+

+
+
+def _cosine_similarity(a: Sequence[float], b: Sequence[float]) -> float:
+    if len(a) != len(b):
+        raise ValueError("Embedding vectors must have the same length")
+    dot = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b))
+    norm_a = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in a))
+    norm_b = math.sqrt(sum(y * y for y in b))
+    if norm_a == 0.0 or norm_b == 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("Embedding vectors must be non-zero")
+    return dot / (norm_a * norm_b)
+
+
+def _embed_text(text: str) -> List[float]:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")

+    payload = response.json()
+    return payload["data"][0]["embedding"]
+
+
+def similarity_score(text_a: str, text_b: str) -> float:
+    embedding_a = _embed_text(text_a)
+    embedding_b = _embed_text(text_b)
